<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#E6E6E5"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="21" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="316" y1="17" x2="316" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="321" y1="14" x2="321" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="326" y1="11" x2="326" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="8" x2="331" y2="21" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="345" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="348" y1="19" x2="351" y2="22" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <rect x="359" y="10" width="21" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="381" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="361" y="12" width="16" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Brand mark -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="68" r="28" fill="#ED1B24"/>
  <text x="195" y="75" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Merriweather, Georgia, serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" font-style="italic" fill="#FFFFFF">Coca-Cola</text>
  <text x="195" y="111" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="2" fill="#2C2929">COMMUNITY</text>

  <!-- Heading and intro -->
  <text x="195" y="153" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="36" font-weight="700" fill="#2C2929">Sign in</text>
  <text x="195" y="181" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#2C2929">Welcome back to your Coca-Cola community.</text>
  <text x="195" y="201" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#2C2929">Choose a quick way to continue.</text>

  <!-- Apple button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="45" y="222" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="42" y="219" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="91" cy="243" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="98" cy="244" r="7" fill="#000000"/>
    <ellipse cx="94" cy="255" rx="8" ry="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="96,234 101,229 102,236" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="194" y="255" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue with Apple</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Google button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="45" y="292" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="42" y="289" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="91" y="326" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#4285F4">G</text>
    <text x="194" y="325" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#2C2929">Continue with Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <line x1="42" y1="379" x2="158" y2="379" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="384" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#2C2929">OR</text>
  <line x1="232" y1="379" x2="347" y2="379" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Email field -->
  <text x="42" y="414" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#2C2929">Work email</text>
  <rect x="42" y="423" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="65" y="459" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">name@company.com</text>
  <circle cx="318" cy="452" r="11" fill="#F1F1F5"/>
  <polyline points="313,452 317,456 324,448" fill="none" stroke="#ED1B24" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="42" y="500" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#555555">We’ll send a secure sign-in link to your inbox.</text>

  <!-- Email CTA -->
  <g>
    <rect x="45" y="518" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="42" y="515" width="305" height="58" rx="24" fill="#ED1B24"/>
    <text x="194" y="551" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Email me a sign-in link</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Terms notice -->
  <text x="195" y="610" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#555555">By continuing, you agree to our</text>
  <text x="195" y="630" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#ED1B24">Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.</text>
  <line x1="109" y1="633" x2="281" y2="633" stroke="#ED1B24" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="663" r="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="188,663 193,668 202,657" fill="none" stroke="#ED1B24" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="694" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#2C2929">Your account stays protected and private.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="755" width="390" height="89" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="755" x2="390" y2="755" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <g>
    <polygon points="40,782 51,773 62,782 62,794 54,794 54,786 48,786 48,794 40,794" fill="#ED1B24"/>
    <text x="51" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#ED1B24">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="132" cy="781" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="139" y1="788" x2="146" y2="795" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="132" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Browse</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="216" y="774" width="17" height="17" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="216" y1="780" x2="233" y2="780" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="777" r="1.5" fill="#777777"/>
    <text x="225" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Orders</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="316" cy="778" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="316" cy="793" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="316" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Circular Std, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="145" y="832" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000" opacity="0.1"/>
</svg>
